architecture: Keep three public async lifecycle APIs in original main owner, including group→broadcast actual global callback seam. Public orchestration retains initial normalization, memo tuple/set, flush, source-contact sync BEFORE memo check, all memo additions/early returns and caller-owned transaction semantics.

Contracts owner contains exact two existing frozen slot DATA classes, kind alias,100/8 thresholds and namespace constant; preserve canonical legacy module/generated method metadata/pickle/actual hints. No inspect monkeypatch or source-location compatibility claim.

Pure event owner contains the entire existing planner and stable SHA256/UUID5 event-ID algorithm. Preserve PII-free payload fields, sorted/dedup role order,100/101 coordinator threshold and source-event hashing byte-for-byte in function ASTs.

Identity/event preparation owner contains named existing reconciliation/read/plan statements and returns only two typed DATA facts: identity_reconciliation and events. Capture previous manifest version in public caller BEFORE reconciliation, exactly as originally.

Journal owner contains exact durable-ID filter and separate version/revision/append/notification statements. Public caller retains None-key initial list and keyed replay branch/early return, preserving allocation/query/evaluation and dedup order. No flush batching, memo lifetime changes, cache, callback bag, proxy or mixin.
